summary: CL Workshop Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of independent director Heung Ming Henry Wong on August 15, 2026, effective immediately, due to personal reasons and not disagreements. The company appointed Haijiang Cui as independent director and committee member on August 25, 2026, and ratified Kin Shing Charles Lau as committee chairperson. This is a routine board transition involving a voluntary director resignation and replacements, with no indication of forced departure or strategic significance. The filing is a standard disclosure of governance changes under SEC rules for foreign private issuers, with no special-situation elements beyond the director change itself.
